results.title: Oyo NNPP Gov’ship Candidate Seeks Probe Into Oranyan Market Inferno
results.description: Governorship candidate of the New Nigeria Peoples Party (NNPP) in Oyo State, Adebiyi Adedapo, has called for an independent and transparent investigation into the Sunday night inferno at Oranyan Market in Ibadan, He described the incident as another disturbing reminder of the vulnerability of markets across the state.
